hero.caption: Allan Moffat in the works Ford XW Falcon GTHO at Surfers Paradise International Raceway, 1 November 1970. Moffat won the 1970 Rothmans 250 Production Classic on that day.Surfers Paradise International Raceway was located in Carrara, Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia.
